asset.name: BackgroundTaskCenter
asset.description: The consolidated view of active and recent long-running operations with progress, status, cancellation, retry, result actions, and history cleanup.

requires.reason: Task state, history, and cancellation belong to the registry.
Task rows use the shared collection semantics.

rationale: Directly relevant to a system where agents run work continuously: without a durable place for long operations, every one of them has to be represented as a toast, and the toast queue becomes the task list.
